activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 6 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: Fronting can establish a time or place frame before the main clause.
cards.explanation: In the closing paragraph sets the context.

cards.statement: It was Maya which called the supplier is the clearest standard form.
cards.explanation: Use who for a person: It was Maya who called.

cards.statement: That can introduce the clause after a focused thing or time phrase.
cards.explanation: That is common in it-clefts.

cards.statement: That is impossible in an it-cleft when the focused element is a non-human noun.
cards.explanation: That is common after a focused thing.

cards.statement: Cleft structures should be chosen for a discourse purpose, not inserted into every sentence.
cards.explanation: Too much emphasis can make prose heavy.

cards.statement: Where can be used after a focused location in an it-cleft.
cards.explanation: It was at the station where the routes met is possible.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 7 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: Who is used naturally after a focused human name in an it-cleft.
cards.explanation: It was Dr Singh who raised the objection.

cards.statement: It was in the archive that we found the letter focuses the location.
cards.explanation: In the archive is the focused element.

cards.statement: What we need is more reliable data is a what-cleft, not a direct question.
cards.explanation: The what-clause functions as the subject.

cards.statement: In the closing paragraph is an example of fronting a discourse frame.
cards.explanation: The phrase establishes where in the text the point appears.

cards.statement: A what-cleft always has do-support inside the what-clause.
cards.explanation: What-clauses use normal statement order.

cards.statement: A fronted time phrase normally requires question inversion in the main clause.
cards.explanation: On Friday, the committee published the report has normal order.

cards.statement: In “What the experiment revealed was a pattern”, the what-clause functions as the subject.
cards.explanation: The subject is what the experiment revealed.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 8 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: At the old station met the routes is the normal fronting pattern in this context.
cards.explanation: Use At the old station, the routes met with normal subject-verb order.

cards.statement: What did we need is clearer guidance is the normal what-cleft structure.
cards.explanation: Do not use question inversion inside a what-cleft.

cards.statement: It-clefts can be useful when correcting who performed an action.
cards.explanation: The focused agent corrects or contrasts a possible assumption.

cards.statement: An it-cleft can focus one element of a neutral sentence.
cards.explanation: It-clefts highlight the agent, time, place or another element.

cards.statement: It was the finance team approved the request is a complete it-cleft.
cards.explanation: The cleft needs that before approved.

cards.statement: In an it-cleft, the focused element must always be a person.
cards.explanation: It-clefts can focus things, places and times as well.

cards.statement: It was after lunch that the meeting started focuses the time rather than the meeting.
cards.explanation: The focused phrase is after lunch.

cards.statement: What the team needs is clearer guidance uses normal clause order inside what.
cards.explanation: The embedded clause is not inverted.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.
